title: Plan config file
description: Parameters a plan-zone script needs and cannot infer from the record. Charter prose states the same cadence for a reader; this file is what a tool reads.

iteration.description: The window velocity is summed over. Changing either field restarts the series.

start.description: First day of the first iteration. Without an anchor a tool can only report rolling windows.

length_days.description: Iteration length in days. One cadence per project.
